description: Gujarat vs Rajasthan, five rounds of official data. Final score: Rajasthan 3, Gujarat 2.

Women paid in cash for work: Gujarat 36.6%, Rajasthan 26.9% (Gujarat ahead; women 15-49 paid in cash · 2023-24 · higher is better)
Women in Atal Pension sign-ups: Gujarat 35.5%, Rajasthan 39.8% (Rajasthan ahead; % of the year's sign-ups · 2024-25 · higher is better)
Mothers: iron folic acid, 100+ days: Gujarat 71.0%, Rajasthan 41.0% (Gujarat ahead; mothers, 100+ days · 2023-24 · higher is better)
Hygienic period protection, 15-24: Gujarat 66.9%, Rajasthan 88.5% (Rajasthan ahead; women 15-24 · 2023-24 · higher is better)
Girls in Class 9-12, enrolment ratio: Gujarat 60.9%, Rajasthan 70.0% (Rajasthan ahead; gross ratio, can pass 100 · 2024-25 · higher is better)

Closing map: Women paid in cash, every state (Rajasthan 3 · Gujarat 2 · India 30.8%). Women 15-49 who worked in the past year and were paid in cash, NFHS-6 (2023-24). Both states outlined. Blank: Lakshadweep, Manipur.
